scope: Enhanced (physically based) renderer: material manifest, generated normal maps, static-light grid and PBR fragment shaders; no game, engine or renderer code imported

retail_evidence.purpose: DTX catalogue (3825 textures) measured by surface.retail to write and check config/materials.json rules.

design_references.purpose: Inspiration for named material classes; its patterns match no retail path and its single-star matcher is not reproduced.

design_references.source: Walter, Marschner, Li, Torrance, 'Microfacet Models for Refraction through Rough Surfaces' (EGSR 2007)
Hammon, 'PBR Diffuse Lighting for GGX+Smith Microsurfaces' (GDC 2017)
design_references.purpose: Approximate height-correlated Smith visibility 0.5 / lerp(2 NL NV, NL + NV, alpha).

design_references.source: Karis, 'Physically Based Shading on Mobile' (Unreal Engine blog, 2014)
design_references.purpose: Analytic environment BRDF approximation used with baked light as uniform environment radiance.

design_references.source: Fdez-Aguera, 'A Multiple-Scattering Microfacet Model for Real-Time Image-based Lighting' (JCGT 8(1), 2019)
design_references.purpose: Energy compensation 1 + F0 (1 / E_ss - 1) for rough metals.

design_references.source: Schueler, 'Followup: Normal Mapping Without Precomputed Tangents' (2013)
design_references.purpose: Screen-derivative cotangent frame; no tangent stream is stored.
